operating_story.current_state: Grounded (AOG) after a borescope inspection finding in the combustor section.
operating_story.consequence: Each grounded day costs about £18,000 in lease and disruption (scenario figure).

components.short_description: Atomises fuel into the combustor. A cracked swirler tip creates a hot streak that damages the turbine.

failure_story.finding: Borescope inspection found a cracked swirler tip on fuel nozzle #7.
failure_story.effect: Distorted spray pattern produces a hot streak on the HPT stage-1 nozzle guide vanes.
failure_story.consequence: Engine unserviceable until the nozzle is replaced; aircraft grounded.

components.display_name: HP turbine stage-1 nozzle guide vane segment
components.short_description: Directs hot gas onto the first turbine blades. Thermal distress beyond limits requires replacement.

failure_story.finding: Thermal distress and coating loss beyond manual limits on NGV segment 12.
failure_story.effect: Reduced turbine efficiency and risk of downstream blade damage.
failure_story.consequence: Segment must be replaced before return to service.

components.short_description: Carries high-pressure bleed air from the compressor case. A flange weld crack leaks hot air.

failure_story.finding: Fatigue crack at the duct flange weld found during zonal inspection.
failure_story.effect: Hot bleed-air leak into the nacelle; overheat warning risk.
failure_story.consequence: Duct must be replaced; aircraft dispatch not permitted.
